# file-glob:ERE. A patch may not add or remove a line matching the regex in a file matching the glob.
# Keeps the agent out of the analysis and coverage configuration. Gradle example; swap for your build.
*build.gradle:sonar|jacoco
*build.gradle.kts:sonar|jacoco
*settings.gradle:sonar|jacoco
*settings.gradle.kts:sonar|jacoco
gradle.properties:sonar|jacoco
gradle/*:sonar|jacoco
